dict.string: Three classes from Heroes of Hammerwatch 1 rebuilt for HoH2: the Thief (knives, grappling hook, smoke bombs; Assassin / Trickster / Shadow), the Gladiator (trident, net, pit fighters; Champion / Beastmaster / Retiarius) and the Witch Hunter (crossbow, hound, pyre, searing torch; Inquisitor / Pyromancer / Hunter). Part of HammerwatchPlus.
